Highlights from the world of college basketball.

20:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: College Basketball
The No. 3 Illinois Fighting Illini visit the No. 2 Duke Blue Devils. Illinois (3-1) beat Sam Houston 108-86 behind Tomislav Ivisic's 28 points, while Duke (3-1) topped SIU Edwardsville 90-47 behind Patrick Ngongba II's 13 points and four assists.
